item.title: Dems Warn ICE Crackdowns Will Make Illegal Immigrants Afraid To Vote
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Democratic lawmakers once again called on the Department of Justice to reign in ICE officers, fearful that mass deportations will make illegals afraid to vote.

item.title: Trump To Convert Entire City Of Minneapolis Into Insane Asylum
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — As part of the executive order to bring back mental institutions, President Trump announced this morning that he would begin by converting the entire city of Minneapolis into an insane asylum.

item.title: College Team Credits Football Championship To Discipline, Teamwork, $370 Million
item.description: MIAMI, FL — The Indiana Hoosiers credited their shocking college football championship victory to discipline, teamwork, and the $370 million spent buying their roster.

item.title: Trump Tells E.U. It's Time We Start Seeing Other Continents
item.description: DAVOS — Speaking in Davos at the World Economic Forum, President Donald Trump broke it to European Union leaders that it was probably time the U.S. starts seeing other continents.

item.title: Minnesota Arrests Churchgoers For Interrupting Protest
item.description: SAINT PAUL, MN — The controversy that erupted over last Sunday morning was finally addressed by authorities, as Minnesota leaders ordered the arrest of churchgoers for interrupting a leftist protest.

item.title: Blind Taste Test Finds 9 Out Of 10 Men Prefer Taste Of Water From Garden Hose
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, MA — A peer-reviewed paper published by Harvard scientists revealed that, in a blind taste test, 9 out of 10 men prefer the taste of water from a garden hose.
